correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a prescribed directed r-cycle fixes exactly r arrows, leaving m=n−r independent uniform arrows. Vertices on the cycle have indegree 1+Bin(m,1/n), off-cycle vertices Bin(m,1/n), yielding the stated conditional E B_2; the oriented-cycle indicator sum gives E[C_r B_2]. Algebra reduces the covariance sign to F_n(r)−n²(n−1) with F_n=P_n(r)/a^r. Its first difference changes sign at most once; the coprimality n⊥(n−1) excludes equality beyond r=1 (except n=3,r=2). The scaling limit has unique positive root of (1−ρ)(1+ρ²)e^ρ=1. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 50,068 functions on n=2..6 and exact sign checks through n=49 corroborated the identity. For m=0,1 zero combinatorial terms are interpreted as zero before polynomial simplification.
residual_risks: Unconditional uniform maps only, exactly-two-preimage vertices, no statement for other degree counts or conditioned mappings; fully relevant 1992 source was inaccessible.
